title: Clear false Launch backend preflight blocks
summary: Refresh the Launch backend-preflight cache during normal app refresh and give launch/start path-health checks the same bounded network-share timeout used by diagnostics.
reason: A stale Launch preflight payload or a too-short path-health probe could leave the app showing a backend preflight block after configured storage was actually reachable.
behavior_before: Global Refresh updated snapshot, queue, settings, and Launch panel rendering, but it did not re-fetch /api/launch/preflight; launch/start autonomy checks also used the default one-second configured-path probe, which could falsely mark a reachable UNC share blocked.
behavior_after: Global Refresh re-fetches the read-only Launch backend preflight on manual refresh and on automatic refresh when Launch is visible or a launch-preflight alert is present. Launch preflight and the start-route autonomy gate now reuse a bounded five-second path-health probe so slow-but-reachable configured storage does not produce a false launch blocker.
tests_added: Updated ApplicationFacadeWebStaticTests.test_launch_controls_are_state_aware_and_topbar_kill_is_emergency_only to assert global refresh re-fetches Launch backend preflight and updates launch button state.
Added ApplicationFacadeProcessLaunchTests coverage for the launch preflight path-health timeout and start-route autonomy path-health reuse.
manual_validation: Python facade probe using the redacted active AppData config: pipeline preflight_status=review, can_start=True, configured_path_health=ready, autonomy_health=review with can_start_new_work=yes

Fresh Tauri instance screenshot under redacted local temp path: Home page shows no Pipeline launch blocked by backend preflight banner and Start / Launch is enabled (shell PID 31348, backend PID 32168).
Fresh Tauri instance screenshot under redacted local temp path: Launch page shows backend preflight as review/at-risk rather than launch-blocking, and Start Run Once is enabled.
apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q: FAIL, unrelated pre-existing static assertions in settings/network evidence surfaces
rollback_plan: Revert the app.js global-refresh Launch preflight block, the launch path-health timeout helper, the start-route autonomy evidence reuse, and the matching regression-test assertions; this restores the prior behavior where only the Launch-specific refresh updates the cache and launch/start checks use the default path-health timeout.
